result.description: A fictional compact ambient projection lamp designed for tabletop mood lighting and room decor. The Orbital Lantern uses a warm-white LED array, silent convection cooling, and a USB-C power input to create slow rotating sky-pattern effects for bedrooms, reading nooks, and creative studios. It is offered as a decorative lighting accessory rather than a storage or computing device.
result.title: Nova Finch Orbital Lantern
result.title_description: Compact ambient projection lamp with USB-C power and rotating sky-pattern lighting
